title: PromptForge Refined Prompt
description: Schema for the structured output of a PromptForge refinement.

objective.description: One sentence: what this work produces.

confirmed_requirements.description: Requirements explicitly stated in the request.

assumptions.description: Reasonable inferences, explicitly labeled as assumptions.

open_questions.description: Questions that need developer input before implementation.

scope.description: What is included in this work.

non_goals.description: What is explicitly out of scope.

repository_context.description: Detected project information. Use {"status": "N/A — new project"} for new projects.

functional_requirements.description: Specific actions or behaviors the system must support.

technical_constraints.description: Framework, runtime, performance, compatibility, and dependency constraints.

data_requirements.description: Data entities, fields, relationships, validation rules, and migration strategy.

api_requirements.description: API endpoints, schemas, authentication, error format, rate limiting, versioning.

ui_requirements.description: Component hierarchy, responsive behavior, accessibility, loading/error/empty states.

error_states.description: Each error scenario and how it is handled (user-facing, logged, recovery).

empty_states.description: What the user sees when data is absent.

security_requirements.description: Authentication, authorization, input validation, secrets, privacy, rate limiting, security testing.

testing_requirements.description: Test types, scenarios, test data, coverage expectations.

acceptance_criteria.description: Specific, verifiable, independent criteria. Given/When/Then or checklist format.

implementation_phases.description: Ordered phases, each with goal, deliverables, and done condition.

verification_commands.description: Exact commands to verify each phase (install, migrate, test, lint, run).

quality_review.description: Self-assessment scores on each quality dimension.

notes.description: Explanations for any score below 4, and improvement recommendations.
